refactoringLog.reason: code-reviewer finding: the skip-dispatch branch added this feature pushed persistCompletion to cyclomatic complexity 8, over budget and worse than the pre-existing complexity-7 debt. Moved everything from artifactFor through the final return nil into persistCompletedStage, leaving persistCompletion as a 2-line dispatcher (measured complexity 2). persistCompletedStage now measures at complexity 7 — the same pre-existing debt level as before this feature touched the file, not worsened.

code-reviewer finding: adding decodePreShipChecksKey and its error check pushed LoadConfig from complexity 5 to 7, a new violation this diff introduced. Extracted the checkKeys -> decodeConfig -> checkValues -> decodePreShipChecksKey sequence into decodeAndValidate(raw, path), leaving LoadConfig as just the os.ReadFile + os.IsNotExist handling plus one call. Measured: LoadConfig now complexity 3, decodeAndValidate complexity 5 — both under the <7 budget.
